'''Ilanka''' was a basso-toned, at times sarcastic, [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] that oversaw the evacuation of [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] during the [[Battle of Gyndine]] at the beginning of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

As the battle's intensity grew, Ilanka joined the retreat and was on board the final [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to leave the system with [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
